summary: Frontend-only e2e verification of CMS-driven mode chip on /course?mode=standard. Admin edited the 'standard' Taxi category (target_route /taxi?mode=standard, id hcat_c290befb06) → user view of /course?mode=standard reflects new label+subtitle in the chip; /home tile reflects new label (same CMS source). Values were restored after the test. All 4 assertions PASS.

assertion_3_geoloc_pickup_autofill.note: Reverse-geocoding to a real address is intermittent (Google OVER_QUERY_LIMIT throttling). Field is consistently auto-populated (lat/lng fallback accepted per request). In iteration 130 the same flow produced 'Av. Gustave Eiffel, 75007 Paris, France' on a separate run — proves the retry path works when not throttled.

restoration.note: Subtitle restored to empty; chip falls back to constants 'Course standard' as expected by RideChoosePage code: modeCms?.subtitle_fr || mode.sub.

test_credentials_used: Admin admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123!. User rider.qa@demo.sb / Rider123! (via /login/email direct). Auth via httpOnly cookie. Geolocation granted via context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + context.set_geolocation BEFORE navigating to /course.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminHomeCategories: the Sous-titre input has no data-testid (label reads 'Sous-titre (optionnel)'). Consider adding data-testid='cat-subtitle-fr-input' for stability — testing-agent had to use label-traversal in JS to set it.
AdminHomeCategories: row Edit (Pencil) and Delete buttons have no data-testid. Adding data-testid={`edit-category-${id}`} and `delete-category-${id}` would make admin CRUD tests more robust.

RideChoosePage reverse-geocoding: when Google Geocoder is throttled (OVER_QUERY_LIMIT), pickup still falls back to raw 'lat, lng' string. Retry loop exists (2 attempts) but throttling persisted across the test run — UX nicety would be a small spinner/loader and a third retry after a longer back-off, or caching last-known reverse-geocode in localStorage.

Mode chip in /course currently relies on first match of target_route containing 'mode=<id>' — if a CMS admin accidentally creates two categories pointing to the same mode= the chip will pick the first found. Consider documenting or asserting uniqueness server-side.
seed_data_creation: None. CMS category hcat_c290befb06 was edited and restored to its original values (label='VTC Réservation', subtitle='').
context_for_next_testing_agent: The chip on /course is now sourced from CMS home-categories (homeCategoriesAPI.public('taxi') match by target_route containing 'mode=<id>') with fallback to MODES constants. Tested live admin→user round-trip plus /home tile reflection. Same CMS row drives both surfaces. Restore step is required: edit hcat_c290befb06 back to label='VTC Réservation' and empty subtitle if any future test changes it. Geoloc reverse-geocode is intermittent due to Google API throttling — accept lat/lng fallback. Mobile viewport 430x900 used.
rca of the issue: n/a — feature validation, no bugs found. Earlier in the run the testing-agent used a label regex /Sous-titre.*FR/ which failed because the actual label is 'Sous-titre (optionnel)' — fixed in the retest with /Sous-titre/. This is a test-script note, not a product issue.
